text:
Predicates:
Supervised(x) ::: x is supervised learning.
Unsupervised(x) ::: x is unsupervised learning.
Reinforcement(x) ::: x is reinforcement learning.
Labelled(x) ::: x requires labelled data.
TextSummarization(x) ::: x is the state-of-the-art text summarization model.
TrainedWith(x, y) ::: x is trained with y.
Premises:
∃x (Unsupervised(x) ∧ ¬Labelled(x)) ::: Unsupervised learning doesn't require labelled data.
∃x (TextSummarization(x) ∧ TrainedWith(x, machineLearning)) ::: The state-of-the-art text summarization model is trained with machine learning algorithms.
¬∃x (TextSummarization(x) ∧ TrainedWith(x, reinforcement)) ::: Reinforcement learning is not used to train the state-of-the-art text summarization model.
∃x (TextSummarization(x) ∧ Labelled(x)) ::: The Machine Learning algorithm for training text summarization model requires labelled data.
Conclusion:
∃x (TextSummarization(x) ∧ TrainedWith(x, supervised)) ::: Supervised learning is used to train the state-of-the-art text summarization model.
